Subject: Re: Wedge MAP — hosted vs dedicated vs private notes

Looping in a couple operational notes you can share with Wedge:

- Hosted: fastest to start (48–72h), built-in model catalog. Good for initial latency/quality validation. Data at rest is encrypted but multi-tenant control plane remains on Redwood-hosted management.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools; predictable latency and throughput; supports customer-dedicated logging and longer KV cache retention. Procurement typically asks for a 30/60/90 day commit cadence.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): supports KMS/HSM, stricter network isolation, and is required for some PHI workflows. Private adds ~3–6 weeks for infra prep + separate support & compliance SOW.

Operational risk + mitigation to surface: if they start Hosted and pivot to Private mid-eval, we'll need to re-run parts of the load validation in the Private environment — budget for that in the MAP. Also recommend a gating item: finalize the PHI data subset by Aug 13 so we can scope Private requirements.

Naomi Feldman
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
